card.name: Inside numbers and units in dosing text
card.fires_on: Partway through numeric expressions in drug labels, such as the space after a range like 26 to, the digit inside P450 or CYP3A4, the 0 in 0.9% saline, or the start of mcg.

modes.label: Number ranges and gauges
modes.description: The space or number right after 'to' in a size or range.

modes.label: Digits inside enzyme names
modes.description: A digit within cytochrome names like P450 or CYP3A4.

modes.label: Decimals and unit starts
modes.description: The leading digit of a decimal or the start of a unit such as mcg.
